digest.component_or_area: gate degrade verdict coverage flags (plan-review and code-review)
propositions: Gate degrade handlers catch LLMInputRejectedError and LLMUnavailableError together, unconditionally setting coverage.llm_unavailable=True for both, misrepresenting input rejection as provider unavailability.
The overloaded boolean name llm_unavailable creates wrong signals for non-availability faults even though resolution_class correctly identifies input rejection via CHANGE_INPUT.
Three consumer readers (drift_floor, orchestrator, review_bot/adapter) branch on the overloaded llm_unavailable boolean and must be updated to honor the corrected signal split.

The fix introduces a separate input_rejected boolean flag, keeping llm_unavailable=True only for genuine LLMUnavailableError/LLMConfigError outages, with a single degrade_cause_flags helper as source of truth.
Consumers map input_rejected to INDETERMINATE verdict and exclude input-rejected faults from RETRYABLE_GAP_REASONS (deterministic input rejection is honest fail-closed, not deferred retry).
